Context: 2. Conditions-

## 2. Conditions-  
- (i) Total OTA payable to a Driver in a month should not exceed 100 hours.
- (ii) On Sundays/Holidays, OTA duty should not be for more than 8 hours per day.
- (iii) On Working days, OTA duty should not be for more than 6 hours a day.
3. When a Driver cannot return to Headquarters the same day and the journey involves absence of at least one night, he will be entitled to draw Daily Allowance, in addition to OTA.
